name: Void Sword
description: Deep indigo void-metal with a seam of cold rift-light running down the blade's centre rather than along its edge — the inverse of every other blade in the collection — dimming from a clipped, chisel-flat point toward the hilt. Pale violet cross guard with a void-light gem set where the blade passes through it, dark corded grip, and a second smaller rift core ringed in the pommel.
